info.name: ScintillaSearch
info.comment: Provides search functionality for use on Scintilla objects.

description.p: A ScintillaSearch object scans the document of a Scintilla object for the Text string. Call Find to locate the first match, then the Next and Prev actions to step through the matches that follow or precede it. The Flags determine the direction of the search, whether it is case sensitive or a regular expression, whether it wraps at the end of the document and whether it is limited to the user's selection.

Each match is selected in the Scintilla object, unless STF::MOVE_CURSOR is set, in which case the cursor is moved to the start of the match. The Start and End fields record the position of the most recent match.

Use Next() to continue a search after calling Find. The search proceeds in the direction indicated by Flags, starting from the most recent match. If the user has moved the cursor since the most recent match, the search starts from the cursor instead.

If a match is discovered, the Start and End fields are updated with its position. If there are no further matches, ERR::Search is returned. The search wraps at the end of the document if STF::WRAP is set.

action.name: Prev
action.comment: Continues a text search in reverse.

description.p: The Prev() action operates in the same way as Next, except that the search proceeds in the opposite direction to the one indicated by Flags.

method.name: Find
method.comment: Searches for the first match of the Text string.

input.param: The byte position to start searching from. Set to -1 to start from the cursor, or from the edge of the selection that faces the search direction if STF::SCAN_SELECTION is set.

description.p: Call Find() to start a new search for Text within the targeted Scintilla object. The search begins at the From position and proceeds forwards, or backwards if STF::BACKWARDS is set in Flags. If no match is found before the end of the document is reached, the search fails unless STF::WRAP is set, in which case it continues from the opposite end.

If STF::SCAN_SELECTION is set, the user's current selection is recorded and the search is limited to it, including any subsequent calls to Next and Prev. The From position is restricted to the selection.
The match is selected in the Scintilla object, or the cursor is moved to it if STF::MOVE_CURSOR is set. The Start and End fields are updated with the position of the match.
To find subsequent matches, use the Next and Prev actions.

field.name: End
field.comment: The end of the most recent match.

description.p: The End field records the byte position immediately after the most recent match, or -1 if there is no match. It is reset by Find.
Optional flags that affect the search process are specified here. They apply to Find, Next and Prev, and can be changed between calls.

field.name: Scintilla
field.comment: Targets a Scintilla object for searching.

description.p: A Scintilla object must be targeted in this field in order to perform the search process. If it is not set prior to initialisation, the nearest Scintilla object in the ownership hierarchy is used.

field.name: Start
field.comment: The start of the most recent match.

description.p: The Start field records the byte position of the most recent match, or -1 if there is no match. It is reset by Find.

field.name: Text
field.comment: The string sequence to search for.

description.p: This field defines the string sequence that will be searched for when calling either Find, Next or Prev. If STF::EXPRESSION is set in Flags, the Text is a regular expression.

constants.const: Search text is a regular expression.
The cursor is moved to the discovered string. If not set, the string is auto-selected.
Limit search to within the user's current selection.
Wrap search at the end of the document.
